# 20_advanced_results.md - advanced evaluation layer (auto-generated by 04_scripts/24_write_advanced_report.py)
Not new hypothesis tests. These analyses quantify how small an effect the study can rule out and check that the null is not an artefact of the model type. They use the same test rows and events as the main analysis.

## 1. How small an effect can be ruled out (equivalence)
For the mortality contrast B - A the 90% bootstrap interval is [-0.026, +0.026] AUC. It lies inside +/-0.03: **yes**; inside +/-0.02: **no**; inside +/-0.05: **yes**. An interval inside a margin means any true effect larger than the margin is rejected.

| contrast | delta | ci95_lo | ci95_hi | se | ci90_lo | ci90_hi | equiv_within_0.02 | equiv_within_0.03 | equiv_within_0.05 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B-A | 0.001 | -0.033 | 0.031 | 0.016 | -0.026 | 0.026 | False | True | True |
| C-A | 0.003 | -0.005 | 0.015 | 0.005 | -0.004 | 0.013 | True | True | True |
| D-A | 0.003 | -0.033 | 0.033 | 0.017 | -0.027 | 0.029 | False | True | True |

## 2. Minimum detectable effect
With a bootstrap standard error of 0.0162 for B - A, the study had 80% power to detect a true gain of about **0.045 AUC** and 90% power for 0.053. Smaller gains could exist and would not have been detected.

| observed_se | mde_80pct_power | mde_90pct_power |
|---|---|---|
| 0.0162 | 0.0455 | 0.0526 |

## 3. Heterogeneity across diseases (random-effects meta-analysis of B - A)
Over 12 diseases the pooled change in AUC is -0.001 (95% CI -0.023 to +0.020); between-disease variance tau^2 = 0.0000, I^2 = 0%; 95% prediction interval -0.025 to +0.023. A low I^2 means no evidence that mortality helps some diseases and not others beyond chance.

## 4. Does a non-linear learner find a signal? (gradient boosting)
- B_gbm - A_gbm: -0.009 (95% CI -0.043 to +0.023)
- D_gbm - A_gbm: -0.009 (95% CI -0.054 to +0.033)

| contrast | delta | ci95_lo | ci95_hi |
|---|---|---|---|
| B_gbm - A_gbm | -0.009 | -0.043 | 0.023 |
| D_gbm - A_gbm | -0.009 | -0.054 | 0.033 |

Permutation importance of the mortality features in the boosted model (drop in AUC when a column is shuffled). A feature can be used by the model without improving out-of-sample AUC overall; that pattern signals fitting noise.

| feature | mean_auc_drop | sd |
|---|---|---|
| allcause_dev | 0.0328 | 0.0147 |
| drug_od_dev | -0.0022 | 0.0047 |
| suicide_dev | -0.0025 | 0.0038 |
| homicide_dev | 0.0100 | 0.0069 |
